{{Quote|These are rare and graceful predators. The kings of Corellian wildlife.|An employee at the Coronet Zoo|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A '''jaggalor''' was a species of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] predatory animals that was virtually identical to the [[Asharl panther/Legends|asharl panther]] and was considered to be powerful and extremely aggressive. Some specimen were kept in the [[Coronet Zoo]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]], a number of jaggalors escaped captivity and roamed the [[Axial Park]] district, attacking anything they came across. Imperial [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Boonan]] was forced to deal with the jaggalor problem by hiring an Imperial hero to exterminate them.

{{Creature-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Jaggalors appear in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as enemy creatures in the Coronet Zoo on Corellia, and are the subject of the Imperial mission "Jaggalors on the Loose." However, the jaggalors use the same character model as the asharl panther, a creature seen on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]].
